http_request_firewall_custom.description: Manifestacoes: bloquear arquivos privados e sondagens sem uso no jogo
http_request_firewall_custom.expression: (http.host in {"manifestacoes.com" "www.manifestacoes.com"} and (starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/.env") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/.git/") or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/.git" or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-login.php" or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-admin/") or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/xmlrpc.php"))

http_ratelimit.description: Manifestacoes: ate 30 requisicoes de autenticacao por IP em 10 segundos
